newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-MIM settles Japan zinc treatment deal.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-MIM settles Japan zinc treatment deal.

text.p: MIM Holdings Ltd said on Wednesday it had concluded 1997/98 (April/March) zinc concentrate treatment charges with the Japanese smelters.
Terms of the settlement were not immediately available from MIM, although industry sources said agreement was reached at US$170 a tonne, basis an LME cash price of US$1,000 a tonne.

The settlement is in line with an agreement reached by Belgian smelting group Metaleurop SA and Canadian miner Cominco Ltd of US$186 a tonne, basis US$1,100 a tonne, when taking into account the lower basis price.
Last year's benchmark price was $190 a tonne, basis $1,000 a tonne.
Rival Australian metals group Pasminco ltd said it has yet to reach 1997/98 settlement charges and has scheduled talks with Japanese and South Korean smelters for next week in Melbourne.
